task: Correct only the unsupported inscription-witness claim in history[1]. A catalogue object name alone does not establish a palaeographic reading of 字 or a Shang-period witness. Remove that asserted inference or clearly qualify the identification as unverified, using the already cited museum/catalog evidence. Preserve otherwise reviewed content, sound tables and images.

findings: `history[1]` claims the catalog listing supports a Shang-period inscriptional witness of 字. The catalog only lists an object named 字父己觶 and does not provide a paleographic reading (`X-29fff02e85a9a4792014`); the museum record identifies 父己觶 as Western Zhou and reports the inscription as 父己 (`X-18a200e93453ddec2ca0`). Remove the claim that the listing establishes a 字 witness, or clearly qualify it as an unverified catalog identification.
